title: 2-for-1 Rooster Roll, 2 Pieces Fried Chicken $4.50, Rippa Roll $5 Pick-up Only @ Red Rooster
body:
Deal: 2-for-1 Rooster Roll, 2 Pieces Fried Chicken $4.50, Rippa Roll $5 Pick-up Only @ Red Rooster

[justtoreply] Rippa rolls are so tiny that I stopped going to red rooster aeons ago. You don't pay their prices to leave hungry
[INFIDEL] You don't pay their prices to leave hungry
$10 Red Rooster whole chicken Mon-Wed never leaves me hungry… at a good price!
